recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless Pharmacy creates a new current-version request about resolving or changing compounded-product ingredient hierarchies.
issue_request: FHIR-12394 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Medication request asking why Medication.product.ingredient could be a Medication rather than only a Substance; the resolution required documentation for compounded medications with base chemicals and manufactured products such as Glaxal Base.
initial_application: The Jira-comment-linked commit b0500f8b520d72851aba346483f21d1ded9a86b3 explicitly included TR 12394 and added the hydrocortisone powder / Glaxal Base compounded-product paragraph to source/medication/medication-introduction.xml while also applying the related FHIR-12764 Medication.product backbone removal.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini. Because FHIR-12764 removed Medication.product, the current relevant path is Medication.ingredient. Current source/medication/medication-introduction.xml still includes the FHIR-12394 explanation, and source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml defines Medication.ingredient.item as a CodeableReference that can target Substance, SubstanceDefinition, or Medication with a Glaxal Base another-medication example. Later related decisions FHIR-16024 and FHIR-36499 preserved and expanded this guidance and already have combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: No source change was needed: the authoritative current Medication narrative and element definition already explain when a manufactured medication product may be an ingredient in another medication.

related_jiras.note: The same application commit removed Medication.product and moved its children, making Medication.ingredient the current equivalent path. It is already audited on the combined branch.

Later Published decision confirmed Medication.ingredient must still allow Medication references for packaged-product ingredients such as Glaxal Base; already audited by e0cc0147e211601c14d5f162ecbc831411d567dd.
Later Applied decision expanded Medication.ingredient narrative/comments while preserving the compounded-product guidance; already audited by 1d94cfaf5484b10a561e1a293688622289bc9b10.
